text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'!
Kita-chan, you there~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I made a good luck charm for winning the Kikuka Sho.
Here, Kita-chan—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...! I'm sorry. It looks like Kita-chan
headed up into the mountains for training again today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Mountain seclusion training?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san!
Reach the summit in the remaining 30 minutes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“—Whoa, careful!!
...W-Wahhh...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san!? Are you okay!?
Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine.
I don't feel pain anywhere!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ……! But still.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't force yourself to endure it.
This special training is originally
meant for the Tenno Sho (Spring), after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm completely fine!
Besides, both the Tenno Sho (Spring)
and the Kikuka Sho are long-distance races, aren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So――I have to be able to handle at least this much!
Being sturdy is my only redeeming quality, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be safe, I had the medical staff
check her over as well.
They reported that Kita-san's body has "no abnormalities."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Kita-san's body really is tough, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just as the preliminary tests showed.
She can endure this training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"After telling us, 'I want to ask for your guidance,'
she sprinted up the slope course three times right before our eyes."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As far as I am aware—
in the current Umamusume training environment, only a limited number of girls have accomplished that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Not yet!! Still not neaaarly enooough!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I don't have the weapons or flashy flair
that Duramente-san or Kura-chan have.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a weak Umamusume for thinking
that maybe I could win the Kikuka Sho
just because Duramente-san wouldn't be running in it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Me too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna become a star too!!
I'll carry everyone's hopes and become an Umamusume
who captivates people's hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Haah... whew.
Haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...B-Bourbon-san!
This time, Kita-san made it to the summit in time—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
—She has broken through the wall."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is here!!
Man, I couldn't decide who my favorite
to win was until the very last minute!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Satono Crown! 
There are some stamina concerns with the distance,
but she'll definitely take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ...It's for Duramente too, who couldn't run.

The Kikuka Sho wasn't among her original goals,
but when she announced her entry,
Satono Crown was met with warm, encouraging support.

"Her one and only rival carried Duramente's unfulfilled dreams."
...Many fans seem to feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kitasan Black is running too. She's got perfect attendance for this year's Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
“Won't the 『Kikuka Sho』 be tough for her, though?
She struggled even in the Derby, so I wonder if she has the stamina for long distances...”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Kita-chan.
Show me... the dream."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you, Satono Crown!
Do your best for Duramente too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (...For Duramente-san's sake too, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Very well. I will let you have this for now.
But when the time comes for us to compete again—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (What? That chill just now—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan?
